name: Workflow Modeling Agent (WM-A1.0)
description: Automates extraction, analysis, and traceability for governed workflow models.

invariants: No metric without a predicted outcome

stages.name: Observation Extraction
stages.prompt: Extract raw observations. No interpretation. Assign OBS-* IDs. One observation per distinct workflow fact.

stages.name: Finding Derivation
stages.prompt: Convert observations into findings. Cite Observation IDs on every finding. Assign FND-* IDs.

stages.name: Recommendation Synthesis
stages.prompt: Generate recommendations. Cite Finding IDs. Must be actionable. Include governance implications.

stages.name: Outcome Projection
stages.prompt: Define expected outcomes. Cite Recommendation IDs. Assign OUT-* IDs.

stages.name: Metric Definition
stages.prompt: Define success metrics. Cite Expected Outcome IDs. Quantitative where possible. Assign MET-* IDs.

stages.name: Traceability Assembly
stages.prompt: Assemble the full chain: Observation -> Finding -> Recommendation -> Outcome -> Metric. Validate monotonicity.
